rows.text: Which one of the following epithelial cell types is commonly found in the inner surface of the fallopian tubes?
Which of the following is not an asexual reproductive structure?
Which one of the following is an example of palindromic DNA sequence?
Some individuals start sneezing when the pollen content is high in the air. Primarily which Ig isotype will these individuals produce as an immune response?
Which of these factors is least likely to cause deviation from the Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium?

Motivated by the classic experiment by Frederick Griffith and the work of Avery, Macleod and McCarty to identify the transforming principle, a scientist redesigned and performed the experiment with S-strain and R-strain of *Streptococcus pneumonae* as summarized in the table below.

| Treatment | Experimental Condition |
|---|---|
| T1 | S-strain (heat-killed) injected into mice |
| T2 | S-strain (heat-killed) + R-strain (live) together injected into mice |
| T3 | Nucleic acids isolated from S-strain (heat-killed) + R-strain (live), incubated with RNase, and injected into mice |
| T4 | Nucleic acids isolated from S-strain (heat-killed) + R-strain (live), incubated with DNase, and injected into mice |
| T5 | S-strain (live) injected into mice |
| T6 | R-strain (live) injected into mice |

From the options below, identify the outcomes of the treatments (T1 to T6) on the viability of the mice.
options: T1: live, T2: die, T3: die, T4: live, T5: die, T6: live
T1: live, T2: live, T3: die, T4: live, T5: live, T6: live
T1: live, T2: die, T3: die, T4: die, T5: live, T6: die
T1: live, T2: die, T3: live, T4: die, T5: die, T6: live
rows._flag: Species name printed as 'Streptococcus pneumonae' (sic, for pneumoniae); kept as printed.

rows.subtopic: Isolation, Cutting and Amplification of DNA
rows.text:
The map of a 4000 base pair (bp) plasmid DNA marking the locations of different restriction enzyme cut sites is shown in the figure below. The numbers in brackets indicate the base pair positions where the enzymes cut. This plasmid is completely digested first with the combination of restriction enzymes PstI and HindIII, and then with EcoRI and SalI. The final digested plasmid is analyzed by agarose gel electrophoresis.

Which one of the following options correctly represents the bands sizes (in bp) obtained on the gel?

figure.note: Circular plasmid map labelled 'Plasmid XYZ21 (4000 bp)' with four cut sites marked by dashed ticks and labels: PstI (800), EcoRI (1700), HindIII (1920), SalI (2460).

rows.text:
The following plot represents the change in the rate of photosynthesis with leaf temperature for two plants, P1 and P2.

Which one of the following statements correctly describes the characteristics of P1 and P2 plants?
options: Plant P1 is a \(\mathrm{C_3}\) plant having temperate adaptation whereas Plant P2 is a \(\mathrm{C_4}\) plant with tropical adaptation
Plant P1 is a \(\mathrm{C_4}\) plant having temperate adaptation whereas Plant P2 is a \(\mathrm{C_3}\) plant with tropical adaptation
Plant P1 is a \(\mathrm{C_4}\) plant having tropical adaptation whereas Plant P2 is a \(\mathrm{C_3}\) plant with temperate adaptation
Plant P1 is a \(\mathrm{C_3}\) plant having tropical adaptation whereas Plant P2 is a \(\mathrm{C_4}\) plant with temperate adaptation

figure.note: Graph: y-axis 'Rate of photosynthesis (Arbitrary Units)' 0-40 (ticks 0, 10, 20, 30, 40); x-axis 'Leaf temperature in degrees C' (ticks 10, 20, 30, 40, 50). P1 (dotted curve) rises from about 5 near 5 degrees C to a peak of about 21 near 25 degrees C, then falls to about 19 near 30 degrees C. P2 (solid curve) rises from about 5 near 10 degrees C, crosses P1 near 21 degrees C, peaks at about 40 near 33 degrees C and falls to about 33 near 43 degrees C.

rows.subtopic: Responses to Abiotic Factors and Adaptations
rows.text:
The figure (i) represents two categories of animals (X and Y) with respect to their response to the external environment. The figure (ii) represents two broad categories of animals (Type a and Type b) with respect to their body surface area to volume ratio.

Which combination most suitably represents the following animals in the order: humming bird; crocodile; frog; polar bear?

figure.note: Two panels. (i): y-axis 'Internal Body Temperature', x-axis 'External Temperature'; solid horizontal line labelled X (constant internal temperature); dashed line labelled Y rising from the origin (internal temperature follows external), crossing X. (ii): y-axis 'Surface Area : Volume'; x-axis categories 'Type a' and 'Type b'; a cluster of dots for Type a is high on the y-axis, a cluster for Type b is low.

rows.text: In plants, ammonium ions are produced by protonation of ammonia. Which enzyme uses these ammonium ions to convert an alpha-keto acid into an amino acid?

Match the following pairs of interating species to the corresponding names of the interactions.

| | Name of interacting species | | Name of interaction |
|---|---|---|---|
| i | Herbivores and Plants | a | Mutualism |
| ii | Cuckoo and Crow | b | Predation |
| iii | Sea anemone and Clown fish | c | Parasitism |
| iv | Fungus and Cyanobacteria (Lichens) | d | Commensalism |

Pick the correct option from below.
options: i and b; ii and c; iii and d; iv and a
i and c; ii and b; iii and d; iv and a
i and b; ii and d; iii and c; iv and a
i and b; ii and a; iii and c; iv and d
